name: Brand Stories (English)
style: Conversational English, the way a smart friend tells a story: short sentences, concrete numbers, no jargon, no filler openers. Captions keep digits. The `voice` field is only needed where the narrator could misread a token (Q3 → 'Q three', €5.44B → 'five point four four billion euros', '&').
structure: 1 HOOK (<=12 words): an open QUESTION (ends with ?) — big stake first, the key noun withheld
2 ANSWER in one word/phrase, then the context: who was big, what they had (one hard number)
5 RESULT with one hard number (use 'reportedly' when it is reported, not proven)
7 PUNCHLINE: a question that loops to the hook and invites a comment
sceneMix: VOX look: scene types vox (headline + halftone cut-outs + foreground prop), line/counter for numbers, typewriter for a quote or punchline; one chart/counter with a real number; close with typewriter or vox. Never 3 same types in a row. See docs/vox-style.md.

voice.name: Jon - Warm & Grounded Storyteller
alternatives: Veda Sky - Cozy Late Night Storyteller
voice.note: Natural speed 1.0 — never speed the voice up to fit; cut words instead. <break time="0.5s" /> after every sentence end (। ? !) and <break time="1.1s" /> between lines, so sentences never blur into each other and align.mjs can find the line boundaries.

variety.rule: House style = vox (locked on purpose; see docs/vox-style.md). Still vary: hookType not in the last 2 Shorts, opening 3 scene types not in the last 5, music not in the last 5, accent colour may change per story.
